          Photos (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF), PDFs, and Word, PowerPoint or Excel files · up to 100 at once · or drop them here

          Photos aren’t re-compressed, so quality stays the same. What wiping can’t do: anything visible in a photo or written in a document can still identify you, invisible pixel watermarks such as Google’s SynthID live in the picture itself, and your file name travels separately, so rename it if it gives something away.

          One archive to open (ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, TAR.GZ, GZ and more), or any files to pack · up to 300 MB · or drop them here

            Save as

            Everything is unpacked and packed in this tab. RAR files can be opened but not made, because the format is closed. Password-protected archives aren’t supported yet. New archives record every file date as 1 January 1980, so they don’t show when you made them.

            JPG, PNG, WebP or a scanned PDF · English · up to 50 pages · or drop it here

            The text reader downloads once (about 7 MB) and then runs in this tab. Clear, straight scans at a normal size work best. Handwriting mostly won’t work. Check names and numbers before you rely on them.
